stem: \[5x + 2y = 31\] \[3x - 2y = 1\] If \((x, y)\) is the solution to the system of equations above, what is the value of \(y\)?
solution: Add the equations to eliminate \(y\): \(8x = 32\), so \(x = 4\).
Substitute into the first equation: \(20 + 2y = 31\), so \(2y = 11\).
verify:
x, y = symbols('x y')
sol = solve([5*x + 2*y - 31, 3*x - 2*y - 1], [x, y])
assert sol == {x: 4, y: Rational(11, 2)}
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [sol[y]]
